terms: ## Conversational Texture User called this 'the simple verify gate story' and explicitly chose '判断+文档化(按 memory 设计)' over a sweeping rename. They are driving the OSS launch and want a verifiable pre-release gate.

## Key Insights This is the program's final verify gate per the user-approved 4-story plan; its primary deliverable is a permanent verify-gate REPORT future contributors can use, not a sweeping code change. The real-misses cleanup is bounded (<50 changes). The historical decision docs (cc-learnings/role-separation/stack-layering) are NEW exception classes that the report needs to formally document — they are honest historical references to the previous product name, not active teaching of koala as current. Same for smoke-test mkdtemp prefixes (regression test fixtures) and .githooks/pre-push (npm package name self-detection).

## Solution Tradeoffs Make the gate a documented report + bounded cleanup, not a sweeping rename — sweeping would break ~600 regression tests and lose honest historical record. The report is the long-term value: future contributors run the same grep and check it against the report to detect koala creep before OSS release. Cleanup is limited to genuine misses where active operator-facing surface still teaches koala as if current.

## Trigger Event On 2026-06-16, after completing the 5 substantive koala-removal stories (B-d313 stale test, B-0b26 dead samples, B-08f2 env vars, B-747e KoalaConfig type, B-d7ef OSS hygiene, B-ed70 lab+.Codex+omx), the user requested the final verify-gate story per the program plan. A `git grep -i koala` audit shows 4,807 remaining hits, of which the 7 already-documented exception classes (.koala/ runtime ~279, LEGACY_KOALA_* ~32, signature salts ~4, framework-audit ~10, activity.legacy-koala ~5, koala-to-lattice plan doc ~50, managed-assets denylist ~29) cover ~409. The remaining ~4,398 hits cluster in: historical decision design docs (cc-learnings.md, role-separation.md, stack-layering.md — written in 2026.04, accurate historical references), smoke-test mkdtemp koala-XXX prefixes + koala.config.json fixtures (regression tests for koala→Lattice rename; changing them would break the tests), scripts/verify-*.mjs (same kind of fixtures), .githooks/pre-push (uses npm package name @koala-agent/core for self-host detection — renaming the npm scope is a separate large effort), and a smaller real-misses set (~30-50 hits): docs/requirements/decisions/authority-client-role.md still teaches KOALA_AUTHORITY_* env vars (B-08f2 renamed those in active code but this doc was missed), docs/metadata/task.json descriptions, docs/guide.md 'Koala/Lattice' phrase, .gitignore entries for koala-debug.log + packages/koala-observer-cli/, .claude/settings.local.json mcp wildcards, CLAUDE.md reference to docs/koala/reviewer-redesign.md.

Create docs/requirements/decisions/koala-residual-verify-gate.md as a permanent verify-gate document. Run `git grep -i koala -- . ':(exclude).lattice' ':(exclude)CHANGELOG.md'` and categorize every hit into either an exception class (with rationale) or a 'should be cleaned' list. Exception classes to enumerate at minimum: (1) .koala/ runtime paths (deferred storage migration); (2) LEGACY_KOALA_* constants in core/lattice-paths.ts; (3) Two signature salts koala-init-check-integrity-v1 / koala-delivery-check-integrity-v1; (4) docs/koala/framework-audit/ (ACTIVE B-META); (5) activity.legacy-koala.jsonl filename; (6) koala-to-lattice-role-naming-execution-plan.md and similar rename-plan documents (canonical naming maps); (7) managed-assets.ts intentional legacy-denylist tokens; (8) Historical decision docs (cc-learnings, role-separation, stack-layering — written 2026.04 with accurate historical product name); (9) smoke-test mkdtemp 'koala-XXX' prefixes and koala.config.json fixtures (regression tests verifying koala→Lattice rename); (10) scripts/verify-*.mjs same kind of regression fixtures; (11) .githooks/pre-push self-host detection by npm package name @koala-agent/core. The report ends with: 'Pre-OSS release verify procedure: run `git grep -i koala -- . :(exclude).lattice :(exclude)CHANGELOG.md` and confirm every hit matches one of the 11+ exception classes above or this story's misses-cleanup section; if any NEW unexplained koala appears, file a follow-up cleanup story before release.' After: the file exists, contains all hit categories with file path samples and rationale.

From CHK-001's 'should be cleaned' list, apply the actual edits. Expected scope (~30-50 hits): (a) docs/requirements/decisions/authority-client-role.md — KOALA_AUTHORITY_* env vars need renaming to LATTICE_AUTHORITY_* (B-08f2 renamed in active code but missed this decision doc — but be careful: editing decision docs trips the 3x2 quorum gate, may need degraded 3x1); (b) docs/metadata/task.json — task descriptions saying 'koala CLI 统一入口' / 'koala test / koala lint' need updating to lattice; (c) docs/guide.md 'Normal local Koala/Lattice' phrase; (d) .gitignore — remove koala-debug.log and packages/koala-observer-cli/ entries (the latter never existed); (e) .claude/settings.local.json mcp__koala-mcp__* wildcards (if any still point at non-existent MCP server); (f) CLAUDE.md reference to docs/koala/reviewer-redesign.md (verify the file still exists at that path or update the reference). Out of scope: any koala hit in any of the 11 documented exception classes. After: each cleaned hit verified by direct grep; build + e2e + lattice validate all pass.
Koala residual verify gate: catalog all remaining koala hits + clean up real misses

Pre-open-source final verify gate for the Koala-removal program (after B-d313/B-0b26/B-08f2/B-747e/B-d7ef/B-ed70). Run a comprehensive `git grep -i koala` audit, classify every remaining hit into documented exception categories (the 7 from memory: .koala/ runtime paths, LEGACY_KOALA_* constants, signature salts, framework-audit, managed-assets denylist, CHANGELOG/history, koala-to-lattice-role-naming plan), document any newly-discovered legitimate exception categories (decision-doc historical design references, smoke-test mkdtemp prefixes that test koala-Lattice rebrand regression, .githooks self-host-detection by npm package name), and clean up the genuine missed-cleanup hits (audit doc still teaching KOALA_AUTHORITY_* env vars that B-08f2 already renamed; .gitignore entries for deleted packages; NAV.md titles; etc.). Output: a verify-gate report committed to docs/requirements/decisions/ that future contributors can use to confirm no NEW koala creep before each OSS release, plus the cleanup commits for any real misses found.
